scientific_integrity: The previously established zero fiber and rank-aggregated counts are credited. The new targetwise claims are proved independently from sum-vector and GL2-fiber arguments.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical coefficient array for rectangular-band semigroup algebras is addressed; no general Rees case. Numeric checks are finite and restricted to small prime fields; the proof applies to every prime power. Full historical priority and external mathematical validation remain open.
title: Prescribed-commutator fibers of finite rectangular-band algebras
